May 8, 2026 RC Crawling Build

The C10 isn't a C10 anymore.

This is another SCX24 I’ve been working on. I bought a C10 version, but I’ve ended up replacing everything except the radio. I should have just bought a kit, but here it is now.

I bought a landcruiser looking body for this and did a rust, mud, and dirt weathering job on it.

The battery hides in a bag I made to look like canvas tarp.

Hidden under the cab is an engine sound simulator.
